sections.advice: Treat Food stop in Prittriching → Photo stop near Penzberg as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Photo stop near Penzberg → Near Grünwald is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Tuntenhausen → Scenic stretch near Ebersberg as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Basque Coast Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Basque Coast Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-santimamine-covalanas-3.story: 209 km from Gernika-Lumo to Gernika-Lumo, about 3 h 36 of riding. It goes by way of Cathédrale de Saint Jacques Apôtre, Eglise Santa Maria de la Asuncion, Covalanas and back through Eglise Santa Maria de la Asuncion. The line favours views over speed.
